name: Shadowveil
description: The Shadowveil bloodline harnesses the essence of shadows and deception. Its members are skilled in stealth, illusion, and manipulation of darkness.

traits.name: Shadow Stealth
traits.description: Increase stealth abilities in dim light or darkness.

traits.name: Illusion Craft
traits.description: Create basic illusions that can confuse and mislead.

evolutions.name: Veil of Darkness
evolutions.description: Surround yourself with a shroud that grants temporary invisibility.

evolutions.name: Shadow Walk
evolutions.description: Teleport between shadows within a limited range.

curses.name: Shadow Curse
curses.description: Embrace deeper shadows to enhance abilities, but risk losing your sense of self.

legacy_quests.name: A Whisper in the Dark
legacy_quests.description: Uncover the secrets of the Shadowveil ancestry through stealth challenges.

legacy_quests.name: The Phantom's Request
legacy_quests.description: Assist a spirit trapped in the shadows to gain unique bloodline powers.
